notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill covers GKE Standard vs Autopilot, cluster and node-pool creation, Workload Identity, Deployment/Service/Ingress manifests with managed certificates, Terraform configuration, and common operations.

Following it can make the agent run billable, state-changing gcloud and kubectl commands with the user's GCP credentials: enabling APIs, creating clusters, node pools (including GPU pools), service accounts, IAM bindings, static IPs, master upgrades, and scaling (SKILL.md:28-113, 193, 265-270). These create or modify resources only at the user's request and include no deletes, firewall changes, or disabled security controls, so medium risk is acceptable; cluster upgrades and IAM changes should be confirmed with the user.
Defaults are security-positive (shielded nodes, network policy, private nodes in Terraform, legacy metadata endpoints disabled). Related skills are named in plain text only.
